> [!NOTE]
> **When microseconds are money:** the high-frequency trading desk will demand more than placement rules and dedicated hardware. <span id="ch1.intro1.2"/> can **pin dedicated CPU cores** to a VM, pass hardware straight through, virtualize hardware using **SR-IOV** (for both NICs and GPUs), and slice datacenter GPUs into hardware-isolated **MIG partitions** so several VMs share one GPU with no noisy neighbors. Dedicating physical resources to a VM buys **predictable, consistent latency**. This exercise is just for educational purposes and not a recommendation for how to setup a high-frequency trading application.
